title: The Oct. 7 Warning That Israel Ignored

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个充满美丽50年历史文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自Audemars Piguet的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In the weeks since Hamas carried out a devastating terror attack inside of Israel, my colleague Ronan Bergman has been investigating what kind of warnings Israel missed beforehand.
sentences.zh: 在哈马斯在以色列境内发动毁灭性恐怖袭击之后的几周里，我的同事罗南·伯格曼一直在调查以色列事前错过了哪些警告。

sentences.en: Today, the story of one of those warnings.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们讲述其中一个警告的故事。

sentences.en: It's Monday, December 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月4日，星期一。

sentences.en: Ronan,
sentences.zh: 罗南，

sentences.en: this is your first time on The Daily and you bring a unique expertise that I'd like you to describe for just a moment because you have been covering the Israeli military and its intelligence services for decades.
sentences.zh: 这是你第一次来《每日新闻》，你带来了一种独特的专业知识，我想请你花一点时间描述一下，因为你几十年来一直在报道以色列军方及其情报机构。

sentences.en: And you've gotten to know those worlds extremely well.
sentences.zh: 而且你对那些世界非常熟悉。

sentences.en: Israel is the country that I think is influenced by its intelligence service more than any other country in the Western world.
sentences.zh: 以色列这个国家，我认为它受其情报机构的影响比西方世界的任何其他国家都要大。

sentences.en: It always had the biggest intelligence community per capita.
sentences.zh: 它的人均情报机构规模总是最大的。

sentences.en: And today, it's the second biggest intelligence community in total number after the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而今天，按总人数计算，它是仅次于美国的第二大情报机构。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, just think of the size difference of those countries.
sentences.zh: 所以，想想这些国家的规模差异吧。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, Israeli security strategy is based on the intelligence services to supply a pre-alert to any kind of enemy intent to launch a preemptive strike on Israel.
sentences.zh: 因此，以色列的安全战略是基于情报机构提供预警，以防范任何敌对意图，从而对以色列发动先发制人的打击。

sentences.en: To supply with viable real-time intelligence what are the intents and the capabilities of the enemy.
sentences.zh: 提供切实可行的实时情报，了解敌人的意图和能力。

sentences.en: And it's vaSt.
sentences.zh: 而且它是巨大的。

sentences.en: It takes massive resources.
sentences.zh: 这需要海量的资源。

sentences.en: And it has a lot of secrets.
sentences.zh: 并且它有很多秘密。

sentences.en: Every day, they create unbelievable stories.
sentences.zh: 每天，他们都在创造难以置信的故事。

sentences.en: Not all of them, by the way, are glorifying them.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，并不是所有人都在美化他们。

sentences.en: Sometimes, the Israeli James Bond looks more like Inspector Clouseau.
sentences.zh: 有时，以色列的詹姆斯·邦德看起来更像是克鲁索探长。

sentences.en: But it's always interesting.
sentences.zh: 但它总是很有趣。

sentences.en: And it's always very consequential.
sentences.zh: 而且它总是影响深远。

sentences.en: There's no historical turn.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个历史转折，

sentences.en: There's no historical event.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个历史事件，

sentences.en: There's no major decision-making process in the history of Israel.
sentences.zh: 以色列历史上的重大决策过程，

sentences.en: The intelligence community didn't have a massive, important imprint, if not the decisive role in that.
sentences.zh: 如果没有情报社区的巨大而重要的印记，甚至是决定性的角色的话。

sentences.en: So, this is my professional task.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我的专业任务。

sentences.en: I'm trying, at least, to give the readers of the New York Times a better understanding of how this secret realm is so consequential on everything we see in the real world.
sentences.zh: 我至少在努力让《纽约时报》的读者更好地理解这个神秘领域是如何对我们在现实世界中看到的一切产生深远影响的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And in your capacity as a journalist deeply wired into the Israeli military and that unprecedented intelligence apparatus that you just described,
sentences.zh: 以你作为一名深度嵌入以色列军方以及你刚刚描述的那个前所未有情报机构的记者的身份，

sentences.en: you, of course, end up spending a lot of time after October 7th trying to understand how Israel's government failed to anticipate that attack or really even blunt it.
sentences.zh: 你当然会在10月7日之后花大量时间去试图理解为什么以色列政府未能预料到那次攻击，甚至未能削弱它。

sentences.en: So, it's always been in my head this question that didn't leave, that didn't stop bothering me.
sentences.zh: 所以，我脑海中一直盘旋着这个问题，它挥之不去，一直困扰着我。

sentences.en: How could this happen?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能发生？

sentences.en: And what I was getting at the beginning when I was speaking with people, even at the first evening, with sources, with officials,
sentences.zh: 当我刚开始和人们交谈时，甚至在第一个晚上，与消息人士、官员交谈时，

sentences.en: throughout the intelligence community and the defense establishment,
sentences.zh: 在整个情报界和国防机构中，

sentences.en: they all said we had no idea, they all said there was nothing, just a total 100% shocking surprise from zero to 100 in a second with no clue, no,
sentences.zh: 他们都说我们毫不知情，他们都说完全没有什么，只是一次从零到一百、毫无头绪、100%令人震惊的突袭，不，

sentences.en: nothing that would suggest that this is coming.
sentences.zh: 没有任何迹象表明这即将发生。

sentences.en: Were you skeptical of that, Ronan?
sentences.zh: 罗南，你对此持怀疑态度吗？

sentences.en: I was a little bit skeptical in this, I would say, spontaneous and very fast admittal into something that an intelligence officer would not like to admit,
sentences.zh: 对于这种可以说是自发且非常迅速地承认情报人员通常不愿意承认的事情，我有点怀疑，

sentences.en: which means that the coverage, the intelligence coverage, human intelligence, signal intelligence, cyber, and all the rest just failed completely.
sentences.zh: 这意味着情报覆盖、人力情报、信号情报、网络以及其他所有方面都彻底失败了。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: The channels were empty.
sentences.zh: 渠道是空的。

sentences.en: So, I thought either it's courageous, people with kahunas who say, we failed.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，要么这很勇敢，是有胆识的人在说，我们失败了。

sentences.en: But because I heard this from multiple, multiple directions, I thought that's a little bit odd.
sentences.zh: 但因为我从多个不同的方向听到了这一点，我觉得这有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Maybe some people are courageous, and maybe some people are very fast to admit something that is very embarrassing, but in order to hide, to cover up on a much darker truth.
sentences.zh: 也许有些人很勇敢，也许有些人很快就承认了一件非常尴尬的事情，但这是为了掩盖一个更黑暗的真相。

sentences.en: And so, I started to speak with sources, and then I think it was two days after the war began when a source said,
sentences.zh: 于是，我开始与消息人士交谈，然后我想是在战争开始两天后，一个消息人士说：

sentences.en: listen, 8200, that's the Israeli equivalent to the NSA, or the British GCHQ, the Cyber and Signal Intelligence Unit,
sentences.zh: 听着，8200部队，那是以色列相当于美国国家安全局（NSA）或英国政府通信总部（GCHQ）的机构，即网络与信号情报部队，

sentences.en: which is the biggest single unit in the Israeli defense establishment.
sentences.zh: 它是以色列国防机构中最大的单一部队。

sentences.en: And also, one who takes the best brains, the best youth when they are being drafted to the military.
sentences.zh: 同时，它也是在年轻人应征入伍时吸收最强大脑、最优秀青年的部队。

sentences.en: So, they said, 8200, long ago, stopped or diminished its dealing with tactical communication of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，8200部队很久以前就停止或减少了对比萨哈马斯战术通信的处理。

sentences.en: But then, after a few days, I get another source who says, this is not even important,
sentences.zh: 但随后，几天后，我得到了另一个消息来源，他说，这甚至并不重要，

sentences.en: because the real story is not about what they didn't know, not about the lack of coverage, tactical or strategic, whatever.
sentences.zh: 因为真正的问题不在于他们不知道什么，不在于无论战术还是战略情报覆盖的缺失。

sentences.en: It's about what they knew.
sentences.zh: 而在于他们知道什么。

sentences.en: There was the sources.
sentences.zh: 有消息来源。

sentences.en: There was something big in the pipeline.
sentences.zh: 正有什么大事在酝酿中。

sentences.en: And he suggests to say, they knew something about how this is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 他暗示说，他们知道一些关于这件事将如何发生的事情。

sentences.en: But the source was vague.
sentences.zh: 但消息来源很模糊。

sentences.en: The source was evasive.
sentences.zh: 消息来源很含糊其辞。

sentences.en: Which, of course, makes me a little bit mad.
sentences.zh: 这当然让我有点恼火。

sentences.en: So, he said, I know this is not what you want to get.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，我知道这不是你想要的。

sentences.en: And maybe one day, I'll tell you.
sentences.zh: 也许有一天，我会告诉你。

sentences.en: And I said, I told the source, listen, if there's a dark secret in 8200, in our days, this will not remain a secret for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我对消息源说，听着，如果8200部队里有一个不可告人的秘密，在我们的时代，这个秘密不会保密很久。

sentences.en: And then, I start hearing something.
sentences.zh: 然后，我开始听到一些消息。

sentences.en: It's codenamed or named the email thread with the southern command.
sentences.zh: 它的代号或被称为与南方司令部的电子邮件线程。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: People start describing something to you as the email thread of the southern command.
sentences.zh: 人们开始向你描述某些东西是南方司令部的电子邮件线程。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I start hearing stories that there's a woman who alerted.
sentences.zh: 我开始听到有传言说，有一个发出警告的女人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Who got it right.
sentences.zh: 她猜对了。

sentences.en: And then, I got access to the email thread.
sentences.zh: 然后，我获得了访问该电子邮件线程的权限。

sentences.en: And in summary, what does it tell you?
sentences.zh: 简而言之，它告诉你什么？

sentences.en: It tells me that there is a veteran professional analyst that is sitting in an intelligence base in the south.
sentences.zh: 它告诉我，南部的一个情报基地里坐着一位资深的专业分析师。

sentences.en: This base is in charge of the intelligence collection from Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这个基地负责从加沙收集情报。

sentences.en: It's a massive base.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的基地。

sentences.en: And this woman is studying the battle techniques of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 这位女士正在研究哈马斯的作战技术。

sentences.en: And so, in July 6th of this year, she writes the first email in that thread.
sentences.zh: 因此，在今年7月6日，她在该线程中写下了第一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: Where she is describing a military drill that Hamas was running in the center of Gaza City with two platoons.
sentences.zh: 她在其中描述了哈马斯在加沙城中心用两个排进行的军事演习。

sentences.en: And she starts and say they were making this military exercise and it was madness.
sentences.zh: 她一开始就说他们在进行这场军事演习，这简直是疯狂。

sentences.en: She is describing the drill.
sentences.zh: 她正在描述这场演习。

sentences.en: The drill, the exercise, including taking down a helicopter.
sentences.zh: 这场演习，包括击落一架直升机。

sentences.en: They are imitating the possibility.
sentences.zh: 他们在模拟这种可能性。

sentences.en: So, they are taking down an Israeli helicopter.
sentences.zh: 所以他们击落了一架以色列直升机。

sentences.en: They are taking down an Israeli fighter jet.
sentences.zh: 他们击落了一架以色列战斗机。

sentences.en: They cross the border into Israel.
sentences.zh: 他们越过边境进入以色列。

sentences.en: They raid a kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 他们突袭了一个基布兹。

sentences.en: They put the flag on the synagogue of the kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 他们在基布兹的犹太教堂插上旗帜。

sentences.en: And then they raid some kind of military academy.
sentences.zh: 然后他们突袭了某种军事学院。

sentences.en: They kill all the cadets.
sentences.zh: 他们杀死了所有的学员。

sentences.en: Of course, there are a lot of people playing dead there.
sentences.zh: 当然，那里有很多装死的人。

sentences.en: From early dawn until the night, they were doing it with bigger forces, bigger capability.
sentences.zh: 从清晨到夜晚，他们以更大的兵力和更强的能力在这样做。

sentences.en: And generally, she says, I never saw anything like that.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，她说，我从未见过这样的事情。

sentences.en: It was madness.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Now, madness is not usually a word that you use in those usually very dry intelligence reports.
sentences.zh: 现在，“疯狂”通常不是你在那些通常非常枯燥的情报报告中使用的词。

sentences.en: She said, Zaya was shigaonu, teruf in Hebrew, madness or crazy.
sentences.zh: 她说，在希伯来语中Zaya是shigaonu、teruf，意思是疯狂或发疯。

sentences.en: It also had a sense of almost, I would say, she was impressed from those military capabilities.
sentences.zh: 它也带有一种几乎可以说是她对这些军事能力印象深刻的感觉。

sentences.en: And at the end of this report, she adds, here is another small addition.
sentences.zh: 在这份报告的最后，她补充说，这里还有一个小补充。

sentences.en: One of the commandos was speaking over the radio with another one.
sentences.zh: 其中一名突击队员正在通过对讲机与另一名突击队员交谈。

sentences.en: And he was using a quote from the Koran, from Surah Talmadah, which is this specific chapter.
sentences.zh: 他引用了《古兰经》中《筵席章》的一句话，这就是那个特定的章节。

sentences.en: The quote was, whoever passes this gate and surprising the other side will get the blessing of Allah.
sentences.zh: 引文是：谁穿过这道门并突袭对方，谁就会得到真主的祝福。

sentences.en: And she says, referring to the adressees of the email, you remember this quote?
sentences.zh: 她对这封邮件的收件人说，你还记得这句话吗？

sentences.en: This is the same quote that is at the very beginning of Jericho Wall.
sentences.zh: 这就是“杰里科之墙”最开始的那句话。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I just want to pause for a moment, everyone.
sentences.zh: 各位，我只想暂停一下。

sentences.en: So, in the days after October 7th, you end up obtaining these highly sensitive internal emails in which this analyst has picked up on an elaborate drill in which members of Hamas
sentences.zh: 因此，在10月7日之后的几天里，你最终获得了这些高度机密的内部电子邮件，其中这位分析师发现了哈马斯成员精心策划的一场演习，

sentences.en: very much seem to be planning some kind of attack and in communicating this drill to the people she works with.
sentences.zh: 他们非常明显地在策划某种袭击，并在与她共事的人交流这场演习时，

sentences.en: This analyst invokes a quote from one of the commandos, uses this phrase, Jericho Wall.
sentences.zh: 这位分析师引用了一名突击队员的话，使用了“杰里科之墙”这个短语。

sentences.en: It seems like that phrase might mean something.
sentences.zh: 这个短语似乎有着某种含义。

sentences.en: What do you end up coming to understand it means?
sentences.zh: 你最终理解它意味着什么？

sentences.en: She uses that twice.
sentences.zh: 她用了两次。

sentences.en: And it's clear that it's not physically the walls of Jericho, which is, you know, an ancient and modern city.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这并不是指物理意义上的杰里科城墙，你知道的，那是一座古代和现代的城市。

sentences.en: It's in the Bible.
sentences.zh: 它在《圣经》中。

sentences.en: The Israelites came and surrounded that Jericho and toppled its walls and conquered the city.
sentences.zh: 以色列人来到并包围了杰里科，推倒了它的城墙并征服了这座城市。

sentences.en: So it's clearly a codename.
sentences.zh: 所以这显然是一个代号。

sentences.en: And she referenced to that codename and says, what we see in that drill is in complete overlap with Jericho Wall.
sentences.zh: 她引用了那个代号，并说我们在那个演习中看到的情况与“杰里科之墙”完全重合。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So suddenly you want to know what on earth is Jericho Wall?
sentences.zh: 所以你突然想知道“杰里科之墙”到底是什么？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so I start asking around, when you say Jericho Wall, you say, ah, the booklet.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始四处打听，当你提到“杰里科之墙”时，你会说，啊，那本小册子。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I hear this a lot.
sentences.zh: 我经常听到这个。

sentences.en: Oh, the booklet.
sentences.zh: 哦，那本小册子。

sentences.en: You mean the booklet.
sentences.zh: 你是说那本小册子。

sentences.en: And in a certain point in a certain military facility, I was able to get and read the booklet,
sentences.zh: 在某个时候，在某个军事设施里，我得以获取并阅读了那本小册子，

sentences.en: Jericho Wall.
sentences.zh: 《杰里科之墙》。

sentences.en: And what is it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: It's a shocking document.
sentences.zh: 这是一份令人震惊的文件。

sentences.en: It's the last updated Hamas plan to attack Israel.
sentences.zh: 这是哈马斯袭击以色列的最新更新计划。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It was obtained by Israeli intelligence after massive effort during 2022, more than a year ago.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列情报部门在2022年付出巨大努力后获得的，也就是一年多前。

sentences.en: And it's about 40 pages.
sentences.zh: 大约有40页。

sentences.en: I saw the translation to Hebrew.
sentences.zh: 我看到了希伯来语的翻译。

sentences.en: This was the one that was shared with many seniors and analysts inside Israeli intelligence.
sentences.zh: 这是与以色列情报部门的许多高级官员和分析师分享的那一份。

sentences.en: And I said, it's shocking because the first thing you realize is the depth of intelligence that Hamas was able to gather on Israel.
sentences.zh: 我说，这令人震惊，因为你意识到的第一件事就是哈马斯能够收集到的关于以色列的情报深度。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: The purpose of Jericho Wall is to take down the Gaza division.
sentences.zh: “杰里科之墙”的目的是摧毁加沙师。

sentences.en: Gaza division is the division that is protecting the Israeli-Gazan border.
sentences.zh: 加沙师是负责保护以色列与加沙边境的师。

sentences.en: They control a massive fence, which is erected above ground and underground to stop the tunnels, but it's also fortified with many cameras and in communication hubs.
sentences.zh: 他们控制着一道巨大的栅栏，该栅栏在地面上和地下建造以阻止地道，但也配备了许多摄像头和通信枢纽进行防御。

sentences.zh: 简而言之，你是说以色列变得沾沾自喜了。

sentences.en: The forces on the border were not sharp, were not ready because they said that the fence is invincible.
sentences.zh: 边境上的部队不够敏锐，没有准备好，因为他们说这道栅栏是不可战胜的。

sentences.en: You see the videos from the day of the invasion.
sentences.zh: 你看到入侵那天的视频。

sentences.en: You see how easy it was for Hamas to break the fence.
sentences.zh: 你看到哈马斯突破栅栏是多么容易。

sentences.en: And you don't understand the gap between invincible and, you know, just one bulldozer just take it out.
sentences.zh: 你并不理解不可战胜与你知道的只需一台推土机就能把它拆掉之间的差距。

sentences.en: What would have happened in a world where the Jericho wall report was taken much more seriously, had been distributed much more widely,
sentences.zh: 如果在这样一个世界里会发生什么：“杰icho墙”报告得到了更认真的对待，得到了更广泛的分发，

sentences.en: and more and more people in the military and in the government took the view of this analyst, for example?
sentences.zh: 并且军方和政府中有越来越多的人采纳了这位分析师的观点？

sentences.en: How easily could Israel have prepared for and prevented the ultimate October 7th attack if they had decided that report, that plan was for real?
sentences.zh: 如果他们认定那份报告、那个计划是来真的，以色列能多么容易地为最终的10月7日袭击做好准备并加以阻止？

sentences.en: So the other day, someone, very high rank, official in the southern front, he calls me and he asked me to come to see him privately.
sentences.zh: 所以前几天，南部前线的一位高级官员给我打电话，让我私下去见他。

sentences.en: So I understand it's something very secret.
sentences.zh: 所以我明白这是一件非常机密的事情。

sentences.en: And when I come and see him, he says, do you know what is Jericho wall?
sentences.zh: 当我去看他时，他说，你知道什么是“杰icho墙”吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I said, well, as it happens, I know.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，既然碰上了，我是知道的。

sentences.en: Because you hadn't, you hadn't yet published your investigation.
sentences.zh: 因为你还没，你当时还没发表你的调查。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And he said, I didn't know until yesterday.
sentences.zh: 他说，我直到昨天才知道。

sentences.en: He didn't know.
sentences.zh: 他不知道。

sentences.en: And I said, okay, what would you do if you knew?
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，如果你知道了，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: And he says, there are two options here.
sentences.zh: 他说，这里有两个选择。

sentences.en: Either you deem the force of Hamas at this moment is too risky to Israel.
sentences.zh: 要么你认为哈马斯目前的实力对以色列来说风险太大。

sentences.en: And then you go to preemptive surprise attack against Hamas to take them down.
sentences.zh: 然后你对哈马斯发起先发制人的突然袭击，将其消灭。

sentences.en: But also acknowledging, we both said this immediately and simultaneously, there was no government, no prime minister,
sentences.zh: 但也承认，我们俩立刻同时指出，当时没有任何政府、没有首相、

sentences.en: no public that would support such a ground invasion before October 7th.
sentences.zh: 没有任何公众会在10月7日之前支持这样的地面入侵。

sentences.en: So the other option is to prepare in case that happens.
sentences.zh: 所以另一个选择是做好万一发生这种情况的准备。

sentences.en: Some steps are easy.
sentences.zh: 有些步骤很简单。

sentences.en: They put landmines behind the fence and some are by far more significant.
sentences.zh: 他们在栅栏后面布设地雷，而有些则要重大得多。

sentences.en: So instead of four battalions, Israel would need to have throughout the year, four to five brigades.
sentences.zh: 因此，以色列全年需要的不是四个营，而是四到五个旅。

sentences.en: This is massive.
sentences.zh: 这规模太庞大了。

sentences.en: We're talking about like 20,000 troops, but there's no other way.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是大约2万名部队，但别无他法。

sentences.en: Because if you think that there is a threat, if they have the capability, you don't need even to think about the intent.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你认为存在威胁，如果他们具备能力，你甚至不需要去揣测他们的意图。

sentences.en: None of that happened.
sentences.zh: 这些都没有发生。

sentences.en: They did not put landmines.
sentences.zh: 他们没有布设地雷。

sentences.en: They did not enlarge the forces because they didn't think it's real.
sentences.zh: 他们没有扩充兵力，因为他们认为这不是真的。

sentences.en: So I have to ask, what has been the reaction to your reporting within Israel?
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不问，你的报道在以色列国内引起了什么样的反应？

sentences.en: The prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, has said there will be a moment to account for his government's failings to prevent October 7th when the war is over.
sentences.zh: 首相本雅明·内塔尼亚胡曾表示，战争结束后，将有一个时刻来清算其政府未能阻止10月7日的责任。

sentences.en: Is what you have found here, the existence of this report and the failure to take it seriously, is that going to mean that when that accounting comes, it's going to be devastating,
sentences.zh: 你在这里发现的情况，这份报告的存在以及未能严肃对待它，是否意味着当清算来临时，将会是毁灭性的，

sentences.en: especially for him?
sentences.zh: 特别是对他而言？

sentences.en: Benjamin Netanyahu is occupied mainly with one thing, to put all the blame on the shoulders of the intelligence and the military.
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡主要在忙一件事，那就是把所有的责任都推到情报部门和军方肩上。

sentences.en: Now, not that they didn't fail.
sentences.zh: 倒不是说他们没有失职。

sentences.en: They did.
sentences.zh: 他们确实失职了。

sentences.en: Their leaders took responsibility.
sentences.zh: 他们的领导层承担了责任。

sentences.en: They said, we failed.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们失败了。

sentences.en: We will conclude the necessary lessons after the war, which is in Hebrew, that means that they will resign.
sentences.zh: 我们将在战后总结必要的教训，在希伯来语里，这意味着他们将辞职。

sentences.en: But first they said, we need to fight.
sentences.zh: 但他们首先说，我们需要战斗。

sentences.en: Benjamin Netanyahu said, it's not me, it's them here.
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡说，不是我，是他们在这里。

sentences.en: They took responsibility.
sentences.zh: 他们承担了责任。

sentences.en: And in any case, we don't investigate now.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，我们现在不进行调查。

sentences.en: Now, if there is a true investigation after the war, what we discuss now, this is going to be one of the main chapters of the investigation panel.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果战后有一场真正的调查，我们现在讨论的内容，将是调查委员会的主要篇章之一。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How could it not be?
sentences.zh: 怎么可能不是呢？

sentences.en: No doubt.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: I was in a meeting where a senior New York Times editor asked a high rank official if there's a moment he regrets in hindsight, that he could, you know, do something else.
sentences.zh: 我曾参加过一个会议，《纽约时报》的一位高级编辑问一位高级官员，事后回想起来，有没有哪个时刻是他后悔的，觉得当时可以，你知道，做点别的什么。

sentences.en: And that person said, we will all have a lifetime to think about that.
sentences.zh: 那个人说，我们所有人都会有一辈子的时间来思考这个问题。

sentences.en: So we're talking about high level officials, but I'm curious how much this attack and the idea that it was preventable,
sentences.zh: 所以我们谈论的是高层官员，但我很好奇，这次袭击以及它本可被阻止的想法，

sentences.en: how that has changed how everyday Israelis view this enormous military intelligence apparatus that we have been talking about here that was supposed to protect them.
sentences.zh: 这如何改变了普通以色列人对我们一直在讨论的这个本应保护他们的庞大军事情报机构的看法。

sentences.en: I think most Israelis didn't need the New York Times to know that intelligence failed because the failure is just all over the defense establishment.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数以色列人并不需要《纽约时报》来告诉他们情报失败了，因为失败在整个国防体系中随处可见。

sentences.en: The failure to prevent and then when it happens to rush the forces and save those people that are being butchered was clear from the first evening.
sentences.zh: 从第一天晚上起，未能阻止袭击，以及在袭击发生后未能迅速调集部队去拯救那些被屠杀的人，就已经很清楚了。

sentences.en: And he writes exactly into the reasons why Israel was established in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这完全契合了以色列最初建立的原因。

sentences.en: The promise that every Jew that comes to Israel will be protected was one of the main cores of the establishment, the DNA of every Israeli.
sentences.zh: 保护每一个来到以色列的犹太人的承诺是建国核心之一，也是每个以色列人DNA的一部分。

sentences.en: That contract between the state and the Jewish people was brutally violated.
sentences.zh: 国家与犹太人民之间的契约受到了残酷的践踏。

sentences.en: When I was a kid and basically throughout my life, everyone always complained about the government, that it's dysfunctional and that it's corrupt.
sentences.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，基本上在我的一生中，每个人都在抱怨政府，说它运转失灵且腐败。

sentences.en: But everybody were also living under the assumption that whatever the government does, the defense establishment is a different island, it's a different universe.
sentences.zh: 但每个人也都生活在一个假设中，那就是无论政府做什么，国防体系是另一座孤岛，是另一个宇宙。

sentences.en: And they might fail from time to time, but at the end of the day, they will supply the necessary security that would prevent any enemy to reach Israeli territory.
sentences.zh: 他们可能偶尔会失败，但归根结底，他们会提供必要的安全保障，阻止任何敌人踏入以色列领土。

sentences.en: That feeling of confidence was hammered.
sentences.zh: 这种自信的感觉受到了沉重打击。

sentences.en: People in Tel Aviv now are afraid to leave their houses.
sentences.zh: 特拉维夫的人们现在害怕离开家门。

sentences.en: And so this intelligence blunder will hunt the Israeli future for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个情报失误将在未来很多很多年里一直困扰着以色列。

sentences.en: Well, Ronan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好吧，罗南，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Pleasure to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你交流。

sentences.en: Over the weekend,
sentences.zh: 周末期间，

sentences.en: Israel appeared to set the stage for a ground invasion of southern Gaza by bombarding the region with airstrikes and ordering residents of several towns there to leave their homes.
sentences.zh: 以色列通过对加沙南部进行空袭，并下令该地区几个城镇的居民离开家园，似乎为地面入侵加沙南部做好了准备。

sentences.en: In remarks to reporters, a spokesman for the Israeli military sought to dispel the idea that Israel's goal of destroying Hamas could be accomplished in a short period of time.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方发言人在对记者发表的讲话中试图消除这样一种观点，即以色列消灭哈马斯的目标可以在短时间内实现。

sentences.en: The spokesman described a, quote, long war that is not bound by time.
sentences.zh: 发言人形容这是一场用他的话说不受时间限制的长期战争。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个全方位探讨设计之爱及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当DJ的时候，你每晚都要带上300件你最珍爱的宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后你把DJ台变成了一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面陈列着价值连城的50年前的老物件。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘文雅。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜之一《连接》的创作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天都创作《拼写蜜蜂》和《字母箱》这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色听联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚刚听到的那些人一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On this vote, the yeas are 311.
sentences.zh: 在这项表决中，赞成票为311票。

sentences.en: The nays are 114.
sentences.zh: 反对票为114票。

sentences.en: Two-thirds voting in the affirmative.
sentences.zh: 三分之二投了赞成票。

sentences.en: The resolution is adopted.
sentences.zh: 该决议获得通过。

sentences.en: The chair announces to the House that in light of the expulsion of the gentleman from New York, Mr. Santos, the whole number of the House is now 434.
sentences.zh: 主席向众议院宣布，鉴于来自纽约的众议员桑托斯先生被开除，众议院目前的总人数现为434人。

sentences.en: The expulsion of Republican Congressman George Santos of New York on Friday over serial fabrications and allegations of theft from his own campaign
sentences.zh: 共和党籍纽约州众议员乔治·桑托斯周五因一再捏造谎言和涉嫌从自己的竞选活动中盗窃资金而被驱逐出境，

sentences.en: has touched off an intense battle to replace him.
sentences.zh: 这引发了争夺其席位的激烈争夺战。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the governor of New York is expected to schedule a special election to fill Santos' seat in February,
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，纽约州州长预计将在2月份安排一场特别选举来填补桑托斯的席位，

sentences.en: an election likely to become one of the most high-profile, competitive, and expensive off-year races in decades.
sentences.zh: 这场选举很可能成为几十年来最受瞩目、竞争最激烈且耗资最巨的非大选年竞选之一。

sentences.en: Santos' former district on Long Island is politically moderate, and both Republicans and Democrats see it as a major electoral prize in a closely divided House.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯在长岛的前选区政治立场温和，在党派势均力敌的众议院中，共和党和民主党都将其视为一处重大的选举战利品。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rachel Quester, Mooj Zadie, Carlos Prieto, and Stella Tan.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由雷切尔·克斯特、穆吉·扎迪、卡洛斯·普里托和斯特拉·陈制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Patricia Willans and Michael Benoit, contains original music by Marian Lozano, Diane Wong, and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由帕特里夏·威兰斯和迈克尔·贝努瓦剪辑，包含玛丽安·洛萨诺、黛安·王和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，并由阿莉莎·莫克斯利担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Rundberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由奇迹之地的吉姆·伦德伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当DJ的时候，你每晚都要带上300件你最珍爱的宝贝去上班，然后你把DJ台变成了一个像这样的，

sentences.zh: 充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面陈列着精美的50年前的老物件。
